_merge_instructions: BASE safety hooks + the Python stack overlay (merged 2026-09-28 for this FastAPI/pytest project). PreToolUse: destructive-command block, 500-line file-size gate, secret block, narrowed config-weakening guard (creation allowed, adding ignore/disable/exclude blocked), pytest unit-test commit gate. PostToolUse: ruff format + report on .py edits. Do NOT create duplicate 'PreToolUse' keys - JSON silently drops duplicates; append to the existing array instead.

hooks.command: SAFE_TARGETS='node_modules|.next|dist|__pycache__|.cache|build|coverage|.turbo'; INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "($SAFE_TARGETS)"; then echo 'BLOCKED: rm -rf on non-build target. Override with user approval.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'DROP\s+TABLE|--force\s+push|push\s+--force|reset\s+--hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command detected.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git\s+commit'; then LARGE=$(find . -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.py' | grep -v node_modules | grep -v __pycache__ | grep -v .venv | xargs wc -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 > 500 {print "WARNING: " $2 " has " $1 " lines"}'); if [ -n "$LARGE" ]; then echo "$LARGE"; echo 'Files over 500 lines detected. Decompose before committing.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git\s+commit'; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d tests/unit ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! ls tests/unit/test_*.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python; else echo 'WARNING: tests/unit exists but no Python interpreter found - commit gate skipped.'; exit 0; fi; if ! "$PY" -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARNING: tests/unit exists but pytest is not installed for $PY - commit gate skipped."; exit 0; fi; OUT=$("$PY" -m pytest -q tests/unit 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUT" | tail -30; echo 'BLOCKED: unit tests failed. Fix them before committing (integration/e2e tests are not run by this gate - they need make up).' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.content // .input.new_string // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qiE '(api_key|api_secret|password|secret_key|private_key|access_token)\s*[:=]\s*["'\''][^"'\'']{8,}'; then echo 'BLOCKED: possible hardcoded secret detected.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(\.eslintrc|\.ruff\.toml|biome\.json|pyproject\.toml|tsconfig\.json)$'; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.content // .input.new_string // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qiE '(noqa|eslint-disable|type:\s*ignore|ignore\s*=|ignore"\s*:|disable|strict\s*=\s*false|"strict"\s*:\s*false|--no-verify|exclude\s*=)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: this edit to a linter/compiler config adds an ignore/disable/exclude rule. LAW 7 - fix the code, not the config. Creating a new config file is allowed; weakening an existing one is not.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$FILE" ] || exit 0; if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check "$FILE" 2>&1 | head -20; fi; exit 0
